assertion.statement: The constant square-sequence boundary of a finite character of G_Qp is zero exactly when chi(-1)=1, and otherwise has invariant1/2.
assertion.hypotheses: Continuous finite-order chi; constant coefficient modules.
assertion.quantifiers: For every listed object satisfying the stated hypotheses.
assertion.uniformity: Only this domain and conclusion; no enlargement of a retained source premise.
assertion.normalizations: Reciprocity inversion does not change the order-two test.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion that squaring is surjective on the sign factor at2.
assertion.limit_order: Local comparison precedes global Brauer injection.

assertion.statement: The parity-selected Dirichlet character chi admits a continuous cochain beta in mu_(2m) with beta^2=chi and delta(beta)=epsilon.
assertion.objects: Normalized inflated sign cocycle epsilon, finite T, finite character chi of order m.
assertion.hypotheses: L/Q finite Galois unramified outside T;2 in T; local signs chosen as in C2.
assertion.quantifiers: For every listed object satisfying the stated hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: G_Q and every finite and real place.
assertion.uniformity: Only this domain and conclusion; no enlargement of a retained source premise.
assertion.constants: m<=2 product_(p in T,p odd)(p-1); no conflation of the two later product bounds.
assertion.normalizations: Constant roots of unity; beta is generally a cochain, not a global character.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Empty sign set allowed; real invariant determined, not omitted.
assertion.limit_order: Match local classes, then global class, then correct the pointwise square root.

assertion.statement: A quadratic global character twist makes beta unramified outside T without changing its square or coboundary; beta|G_L is invariant and its kernel gives L′/Q Galois of degree at most2m[L:Q].
assertion.objects: beta, chi, epsilon, L and quadratic Q(sqrt(P)).
assertion.hypotheses: C2 identities; L/Q unramified outside T;2 in T.
assertion.quantifiers: For every listed object satisfying the stated hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: All inertia outside T; finite product P of odd primes.
assertion.uniformity: Only this domain and conclusion; no enlargement of a retained source premise.
assertion.normalizations: The twist multiplies the sign cochain only; a_sigma remains separate.
assertion.exceptional_cases: P=1 is permitted; additional dyadic ramification lies inside T.
assertion.limit_order: Prove character/invariance, identify finite bad inertia set, then twist.

assertion.statement: The full coefficient-conjugate span of the same primitive weight-two f is stable under h(z)->h(-1/(Nz))/z^2.
assertion.objects: f, full coefficient field K, every embedding sigma:K->C, V=sum C f^sigma.
assertion.hypotheses: Normalized primitive weight-two cusp form of level N; exact r5/f identity is a separate input.
assertion.quantifiers: For every listed object satisfying the stated hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: All N and nebentypus, arbitrary coefficient field.
assertion.uniformity: Only this domain and conclusion; no enlargement of a retained source premise.
assertion.constants: Shimura map=N times Li weight-two slash.
assertion.normalizations: Li K_op is coefficient conjugation; c composes with each embedding.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No single-form Fricke eigenvector or rational-character assumption.
assertion.limit_order: Unconditional conjugate existence and primitivity first; Fricke condition second.

assertion.statement: For the same f, Shimura gives q:J1(N)->A_f over Q, K-action, dimension[K:Q], conjugate differential span and the product Euler identity outside finitely many primes.
assertion.hypotheses: f normalized Hecke eigenform; C4 supplies Fricke stability for Gamma1(N).
assertion.quantifiers: For every listed object satisfying the stated hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: Q-quotient at the original final primitive level N.
assertion.uniformity: Only this domain and conclusion; no enlargement of a retained source premise.
assertion.normalizations: The quotient and differential assertions precede the conditional Euler formula.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The separate Gamma0 occurrence uses the source alternative clause; its isogeny to E is not proved here.
assertion.limit_order: Construct quotient unconditionally; apply the verified Fricke premise for Euler factors.

assertion.statement: The same r5 occurs in V5(A_f) and V5(J1(N)); its dual occurs in H1_et(A_f), and local Artin/WD conductor is unchanged by duality.
assertion.objects: Chosen r5, all conjugate modular realizations, A_f and J1(N).
assertion.hypotheses: C5 Euler identity; modular attachments, Faltings semisimplicity and Serre density/trace lemma.
assertion.quantifiers: For every listed object satisfying the stated hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: Common finite5-adic coefficient extension; all local dual conductor comparisons.
assertion.uniformity: Only this domain and conclusion; no enlargement of a retained source premise.
assertion.constants: No extra field-degree, Tate-twist or conductor factor.
assertion.normalizations: Tate arithmetic Frobenius versus geometric Frobenius on cohomology; duality has no Tate twist.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No conclusion that arbitrary labelled factors follow directly from an unlabelled product; level=conductor is retained separately.
assertion.limit_order: Compare total semisimple representations, select chosen constituent, then dualize.
